'''C0-RA''' was an [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was present at the [[Jedi Colony]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=location|Ossus}}</ref>
